description: This file is an Android activity class named NoteEditorActivity, responsible for creating or editing notes within a note-taking app. It manages UI components such as EditTexts for title and content, handles loading existing notes, and saving changes via a NoteRepository.

classes.name: NoteEditorActivity
classes.description: Android activity class for editing or creating notes, including UI setup, loading notes, and saving functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, and loads an existing note if an ID is provided.

methods.name: loadNote
methods.description: Loads a note from the repository asynchronously and updates UI components.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu to include a save action.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections such as saving the note or navigating up.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Validates input and saves the note via the repository, either adding a new note or updating an existing one.
